text: MRPeasy vs Katana. Not the same job.
MRPeasy is a manufacturing ERP. Planning, CRM and accounts in every plan.
Katana is cloud inventory software for product businesses. Production is one part of it.
They charge in opposite ways. MRPeasy: per user, per month, on four plans.
Katana: free up to 30 SKUs. After that, one annual price, not per user.
And raw materials count as SKUs too.
Both connect to Xero and QuickBooks Online. Neither lists MYOB.
Hard part is planning? MRPeasy. Selling online? Katana.
Read the full comparison at zudoworks.com
